title: L'homme qui a attaqué une garderie suisse a trouvé ses victimes sur ChatGPT

reports.title: Messerangriff auf Kinder: Täter «kaufte Rindfleisch, um zu üben»
Chinese hatte Tat zusammen mit ChatGPT geplant!
Zürich-Oerlikon: Angriff auf Kinder eines Kinderhortes mit Verletzungsfolgen
L'homme qui a attaqué une garderie suisse a trouvé ses victimes sur ChatGPT

summary:
A 23 year old Chinese student is on trial in Zurich for attempted murder after stabbing three five year old boys outside a childcare centre in Oerlikon on 1 October 2024. He used a knife with an 8.5 centimetre blade, seriously injuring all three children. One boy had a neck vein cut and needed emergency surgery, another suffered heart and artery wounds and barely survived, and the third was hurt in the ear and lung. A childcare worker grabbed his arms, forcing him to drop the knife, and passersby held him until police arrived.

Prosecutors say he planned the attack for weeks, using ChatGPT to research legal consequences and deciding to target children. He bought clothes and kitchen knives, studied human anatomy, and bought raw beef to practise stabbing the day before. On the morning of the attack he posted patriotic Chinese messages on Instagram. The prosecution describes his motive as revenge, a need for recognition, and ideological delusion, and is seeking a 15 year prison sentence and a 15 year expulsion from Switzerland. He appeared in court on Thursday.
title_en: The man who attacked a Swiss daycare found his victims on ChatGPT
